_comment: Campaign spine plan section 3 (Abe, 2026-10-05): the Hidden Hand wants what's at the Lodestar. Each Lodestar hosts the Hidden Hand goals listed here, with an authored bridge: why that person needs that place. At season start the goal is drawn from the Lodestar's hosted goals. Bridges are director text that may be shown at the reveal and the climax; they never name the culprit (the code adds that) and stay clear of the fixed-cast canon. All bridges approved by Abe 2026-10-05. Every Hidden Hand goal is hosted somewhere and none by more than 3 Lodestars.

lighthouse.own_the_lanes: The Lighthouse remembers routes nobody else charts. Whoever owns its map owns lanes no tariff office knows exist.
lighthouse.escape_a_debt: A route off every chart is a way out from under every creditor. The Lighthouse's map is the door.
lighthouse.silence_a_witness: The witness took the old routes to disappear, and only the Lighthouse knows where they lead.
lighthouse.bury_old_crime: The beacon logs every ship that ever asked it for a course. One of those logs puts them where they swore they never were.

silent_fleet.protect_a_secret_child: Someone they love went dark with the fleet. Keeping the fleet hidden is keeping them safe.
silent_fleet.bury_old_crime: The fleet ran from a war, and from the crime that started it. If the fleet is found, so is what they saw.
silent_fleet.start_a_war: The fleet's settlement is the one place both sides would kill to claim. Point them at it and the war starts itself.
silent_fleet.silence_a_witness: Somewhere in that fleet is the last witness. Reach the fleet first, and the testimony never comes.

humming_gate.own_the_lanes: A working gate is a lane nobody else can use. Whoever holds the ring holds the region's trade.
humming_gate.take_the_chair: The council seat goes to whoever brings the ring under their flag. It was promised to someone else. It won't be theirs for long.
humming_gate.start_a_war: Two factions already circle the ring. One push and they fight over it, and whoever pushed sells to both.
humming_gate.keep_the_lights_on: Their colony's gate is failing. The ring is the only thing left that can fix it.

cartographer.rewrite_a_verdict: The surveyor's chart proves where someone really was. The verdict that ruined their family stands on a lie the chart can undo.
cartographer.break_a_rival: The consortium mining in secret is their rival. Expose the mine and the rival is finished.
cartographer.prove_them_wrong: The registry swore that system never existed. The chart proves the whole institution lied.
cartographer.buy_a_station: The secret mine is worth a fortune while nobody knows it's there. Expose it, let the price crash, and buy it for nothing.

garden.protect_a_secret_child: Someone they love lives among the Garden's keepers, hidden from everyone who'd use them.
garden.keep_the_lights_on: A world where food grows by itself. A starving colony would trade anything for it, and take it if trading fails.
garden.break_a_rival: The mining fleet two jumps behind belongs to their rival. Get there first and the rival's claim dies.
garden.prove_them_wrong: The survey office declared everything out here barren, so their people were sent to a contested world instead, and the war over it cost them everything. The Garden proves it never had to happen.

quiet_war.bury_old_crime: The war was erased from history. What happened on that battlefield is the crime they're burying.
quiet_war.start_a_war: The cache of old technology is reason enough for a new war. Let both sides learn where it is.
quiet_war.silence_a_witness: The last survivor of that battle knows who fired first.
quiet_war.rewrite_a_verdict: The battlefield shows who really started it. The verdict blamed the wrong side, and their family paid for it.

hollow_market.escape_a_debt: At the Market a name can be bought clean and a debt sold to people who never collect. One trip there, and the debt that would follow them to the grave dies instead.
hollow_market.own_the_lanes: Half the region's untaxed cargo moves on the Market's hidden routes. Whoever controls its keepers controls the lanes nobody watches.
hollow_market.buy_a_station: A station drowning in debt can have its paper bought at the Market for almost nothing, by whoever made sure it was drowning.
hollow_market.break_a_rival: At the Market anything is for sale, including a rival's secrets, debts and invented crimes. Buy enough of them and the rival is nobody.

last_shipyard.take_the_chair: The yard's family elects a head every year, and the seat was promised to someone else. Whoever holds it decides whether the Long Promise ever flies.
last_shipyard.prove_them_wrong: Every guild and registry said the great ship could never fly. Launch it, and every one of them is wrong in front of the whole frontier.
last_shipyard.keep_the_lights_on: A ship that size could carry a failing colony away, or keep one alive on its reactors. Someone needs it, whatever it costs the family.
last_shipyard.protect_a_secret_child: Someone they love is hidden in the shipwright family under another name. Keep the yard closed, and they stay hidden.

archive.rewrite_a_verdict: The Archive holds the full record of the trial that ruined their family, including what the court left out. One page from its stacks could overturn the verdict.
archive.bury_old_crime: Somewhere in the Archive's stacks is the one record that ties them to an old crime. While the Archive stands, the crime is never really buried.
archive.prove_them_wrong: The Archive's copies show the registry, the courts and the guild all lied about the same thing for decades. Publish them, and the institution falls.
archive.take_the_chair: The seat they want was promised to someone else, in a charter only the Archive still holds. Change that page, and the promise never existed.

neutral_ground.start_a_war: One shot fired inside the hall, and each side will blame the other. A war that starts at the Neutral Ground pays whoever sells to both.
neutral_ground.take_the_chair: The hall's keeper speaks for the treaty, and the seat was promised to someone else's heir. Whoever holds it decides who gets to talk.
neutral_ground.rewrite_a_verdict: The treaty tribunal ruled against their family when the war ended. The original minutes are still in the hall, and they say something else.
neutral_ground.break_a_rival: Their rival is the envoy every faction trusts at the Neutral Ground. Disgrace them there, in front of everyone, and they're finished everywhere.
